name: Presidio Garden
cadence: Every other week during the growing season - sometimes more often, sometimes less.
description: We rent a large plot here. The garden itself is run by Community Gardens of Tucson, not by us: holding a plot means paying a plot fee and taking out a membership with them, so this is not a place to come and find us. What the plot grows is either cooked into the food we hand out or given straight to people in the group and to neighbors who need it.
